title: NoiseQA: Challenge Set Evaluation for User-Centric Question Answering
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of Question Answering systems to different types of interface noise (ASR, keyboard, machine translation). It does not contain any component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The discussion of bias pertains to system performance variation based on user characteristics like accent, not on ethical or moral content.
